fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { earlyStageSaas: "Build a product market fit survey for my shift-scheduling app. Send it only to users who opened the app at least twice in the last 2 weeks. Ask how they would feel if they could no longer use it, with very disappointed, somewhat disappointed, and not disappointed as the answers. Show the share of very disappointed answers against a 40% line, with the reply count beside it.", roleSegments: "Create a product market fit survey for my proposal-design tool. Ask each person for their role first: agency owner, freelancer, or in-house designer. Then ask the must-have question with its three answers. Show the overall very disappointed share and the share for each role, with the number of replies behind each one, so I can see which role needs the product most.", scoreOverTime: "Build a product market fit survey for my route-planning app that goes to each quarter's new users once and never to the same person twice. Chart the very disappointed share by quarter next to the number of replies. When a quarter closes above 40%, post the score to our #product channel in Slack.", mobileApps: "Make a phone survey for my habit-tracking app with one question per screen. Start with the must-have question and its three answers. Then ask for the main benefit from a short list: streak reminders, weekly charts, or shared goals. Count the main benefit answers from the users who picked very disappointed." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-title: How to Create a Product Market Fit Survey
fieldData.awb---how-to-description: Seven steps to create a product market fit survey that scores your must-have users and shows which segment to build for.
fieldData.alpb---prompt: Build a product market fit survey that collects every answer in a database I own.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A product market fit survey dashboard for Driftpine shows 64 of 186 users answered and 23 picked very disappointed, a 36% share that sits 4 points under the 40% threshold.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A product market fit survey for Brightloom splits 140 replies by role: 25 of 48 agency owners picked very disappointed, against 9 of 52 freelancers and 7 of 40 in-house designers.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A product market fit survey for Sablecrest Routes charts each quarter's new users: 61 of 197 very disappointed in Q1, 74 of 200 in Q2, and 89 of 212 in Q3, posted to the #product channel in Slack.

asqb---cover-image.alt: A product market fit survey score card showing 42% of new users would be very disappointed, up 5 points on the quarter before.
